title: Fit intelligence inside a physical deadline
description: Choose an operating envelope and model placement, then tune inference latency. The lab traces how stale sensor data and compute delay consume the time reserved for a safe response.
modelNote: These are teaching fixtures, not universal robot limits. Measure deadlines, stopping behavior, and p95 or p99 latency on the actual embodiment.

scenarios.label: Guarded warehouse pick
scenarios.detail: A fixed arm picks known packages inside a controlled cell.

scenarios.label: Human handover
scenarios.detail: A collaborative arm passes an object to a moving person.

scenarios.label: Remote inspection rover
scenarios.detail: A slow rover navigates a mapped industrial corridor.

placements.label: On-robot accelerator
placements.detail: No network dependency; power and thermal headroom constrain the model.

placements.label: Cell edge GPU
placements.detail: More compute, but the control path now includes a local network hop.

placements.label: Remote model service
placements.detail: Largest model capacity, with wide-area latency and a larger jitter tail.
placements.availability: Must fail closed when connectivity degrades
